# Ginger

deceased

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P6](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0006), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)</sub>
- **Status:** deceased  <sub>[v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P59](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0059)</sub>

## Appearance

Ginger has green and gold feathers that he can ruffle until he resembles a small ball of those colors. He also features wicked golden eyes, through which he peers from his cage.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P3](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0003), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P36](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0036)_

## Personality

Ginger is known for her profane habits of speech. She also maintains a suspicious attitude toward others, frequently greeting them with sarcasm.

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)_

## Traits

- suspicious  <sub>[v2 IV Different Opinions P28](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Abilities

- profane habits of speech  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Ginger was a parrot sent to [James A](../character/james-a.md). [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) by his dying sailor brother. During a visit from [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), Ginger insulted her while Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) calmly handled the news of his sold cow.

_Sources: [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P8](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0008), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P20](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0020), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P23](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0023), [v2 III Mr. Harrison at Home P35](../source/v02-c03.md#nw-v02-c03-p0035), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), +3 more_
